results.evidence: IAQ-008 v2 controller, closed request DTO, owner path, filters, sort allowlist, limit and relationship-grain projection are covered by Hrm011IaEntryQueryContractTest and the frontend slice/API contracts.
COMPLETE, EMPTY, PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE states, cursor authority binding, exact field-decision summaries and locale/time-zone validation are covered by the IAQ and frontend workbench tests.

The owner selects one effective relationship, primary assignment, compensation basis and scope-matched PDX-015; ambiguous or incomplete candidates become typed non-actionable failures. PostgreSQL verifies filtering and deterministic order before limit.
PEP-HRM-011 accepts the sealed seven-field body, canonical strong If-Match, expected version, idempotency and correlation headers, rejects unknown input and returns only an exact HTTP 202 receipt.

Exact v53 route/capability, permission, trusted purpose mapping, HRM-AUTH-015, target population lock, NO_APPROVE_OWN_CHANGE and HIGH step-up are enforced. The route-specific field policy is correctly separated from the V34 workforce-population namespace.
Same-hash replay, different-hash conflict, canonical version checks and a real two-transaction PostgreSQL reservation race prove one provider invocation and one durable receipt.
V59 creates exactly four sealed tables and reuses receipt, audit and outbox stores. Static migration contracts and seven PostgreSQL migration cases passed with zero skips.

SVC-PEP-HRM-003-R2 accepts only the trusted payroll workload, never fabricates payGroupPublicId and returns an empty homogeneous page until a typed source is separately admitted; exact audit recording is transactional and fail closed.

SVC-PEP-HRM-005 authenticates the workload and cursor, emits one strict minimized projection type per request, excludes raw restricted values and writes the exact ten-field audit envelope transactionally.

XCON-023 through XCON-026 use closed deterministic envelopes and equality checks. Persistent outbox exact duplicate is idempotent while digest or content drift fails without overwrite; pre-existing XCON contracts are unchanged.

PDX-015 and artifact ports fail closed. Real PostgreSQL proves provider success followed by an outbox failure rolls back contract, receipt, audit and outbox, and retry reuses the deterministic artifactRequestId.

The unmounted frontend covers loading, empty, partial, unavailable, denied, stale and complete states, HTTP 202 fencing, immutable snapshot refresh, retry, keyboard flow, 1440/1280/390/320 and 200%-zoom-equivalent layouts, default-OFF and zero-call behavior.

nonClaims: The dedicated workload ingress is not yet admitted into PeopleSecurityFilter or the final People security chain.
No production template provider, artifact provider or XCON-007/XCON-023/XCON-024/XCON-025 mutation trigger is bound.
The frontend feature is not mounted into a route or menu.
The feature remains default OFF with zero enrolled tenants and no customer data.
This module result does not claim production activation, release or full-slice business completion before central admission.
